cells.reason: The firm states fee-based (advisory) assets as a percentage of Private Client Group AUA, which is the advisory portion of the cash/advisory/brokerage mix.

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry stated that approximately 65% of the firm's overall Private Client Group assets are fee-based (advisory), while also continuing to offer a brokerage solution.
items.quote: We're now at 65%, or so of our overall assets in the Private Client Group, are fee-based. We've always really led the industry in fee-based penetration.
items.definition: fee-based penetration (fee-based assets as a percentage of overall PCG client assets)

items.text: Raymond James reported that fee-based accounts represented 60.5% of Private Client Group assets under administration as of September 30, 2025.
items.quote: Percent of AUA in fee-based accounts 60.5 %
items.definition: Percent of AUA in fee-based accounts

items.text: Raymond James reported that fee-based accounts represented 60.9% of Private Client Group assets under administration as of December 31, 2025.
items.quote: Percent of AUA in fee-based accounts 60.9 %
items.definition: Percent of AUA in fee-based accounts

items.text: Raymond James reported that clients' domestic cash sweep and Enhanced Savings Program balances were $58.8 billion, representing 3.4% of domestic Private Client Group assets under administration, as of June 30, 2026.

items.scope: domestic Private Client Group (cash sweep and ESP)
items.definition: Clients' domestic cash sweep and Enhanced Savings Program (ESP) balances as a percentage of domestic PCG assets under administration

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry stated that equities are roughly 60% of client assets on an X-ray basis, and that the mix shift over the last five years has been within the cash category, with more transactional cash in low-rate environments and more investable cash in higher-rate environments.
items.quote: equities for us right now is roughly 60% on an X-ray basis of assets... the mix shift that you've seen, over the last 5 years has really been within the cash category when it's a low-rate environment. There's more in transactional cash, and when you're in a higher rate environment, there's more investable cash there.

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry stated that many clients hold both a fee-based (advisory) account and a commission-based (brokerage) account, with the mix driven by what is best for clients.
items.quote: A lot of clients have both a fee-based account and a commission-based account, because they have assets that have different objectives and priorities around them... It is a mix, and it is really driven by what is best for clients.
